items.text: FT: "Small batches of Nvidia’s H200 chips have been allowed to enter mainland China, as Beijing tries to aid its leading AI companies in the race to catch up with US rivals. ByteDance and Tencent have each received about 10,000 H200 processors in recent weeks, while a few other Chinese tech groups could soon obtain approval for shipments of similar size, according to two people with knowledge of the matter. The H200 is at least two generations behind Nvidia’s most powerful chips, which Chinese customers are not allowed to buy due to US export controls."
